parameters.title: What the row is.
parameters.subtitle: One caption line under the title.
parameters.below: Places secondary content beneath the row’s title and subtitle.
parameters.icon: The row's 18 px glyph, in the quiet ink unless iconColor says otherwise.
parameters.leading: Places a widget before the main label.
parameters.leadingWidth: Reserves space for the leading content.
parameters.trailing: Places a widget at the trailing edge.
parameters.meta: Displays a short secondary value beside the title.
parameters.metaWidth: Reserves room for the secondary value.
parameters.metaLabel: Supplies the accessible name for the secondary value.
parameters.onTap: Runs when the reader activates the component. Leave it unset for a read-only item.
parameters.chevron: Show a chevron affordance (the row pushes a page).
parameters.destructive: Applies the destructive treatment to the row.
parameters.selected: Indicates whether the item is selected.
parameters.muted: Uses the muted text treatment for this row.
parameters.enabled: Controls whether the row accepts input.
parameters.padding: Sets the space between the frame and its content.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
